verses.1: We therefore fear that anyone among you might try to enter the state of oblivion after the message has been forgotten.
verses.2: And indeed, we were also sent as messengers, just like those others. But the message of his words did not please them; they were not convinced by what he said.
verses.3: For we shall enter into salvation, those who believe, as it is said: “May they be saved from my wrath.” Even if they are sent into my punishment, yet the works that originated from the creation of the world will still be punished.
verses.4: For it was said that on the seventh day, God would cease all his works.
verses.5: And once again, if they are sent to my punishment.
verses.6: Since some people refuse to go into her, and those who were previously evangelized did not go in because of fear.
verses.7: Once again, someone will mark a day as special. Today, in David’s time, after all this time has passed, if you hear his voice, do not harden your hearts.
verses.8: For if Jesus had forgiven them, they would not have suffered so much on that day.
verses.9: Therefore, the Sabbath will be abolished for the people of God.
verses.10: For he who entered into his rest also ceased to carry out his duties, just as God ceased to carry out His own duties.
verses.11: Therefore, we strive to enter that place of redemption, so that no one may be a source of temptation or danger for others.
verses.12: For in life, the word of God is active and destructive to all evil forces. It penetrates deep into the soul and spirit, affecting every aspect of our being. It also serves as a judge of our emotions and thoughts.
verses.13: And it isn’t a simple construction in front of him; everything is naked and four-sided to his eyes. This is what the Word says about us.
verses.14: Having thus given the high priest authority over the heavens, Jesus, the Son of God, remained faithful to this covenant.
verses.15: For we do not have an archbishop who is unable to show compassion for our weak and sickly ones. On the contrary, he is tested in every situation, always in accordance with righteousness.
verses.16: Therefore, we shall approach the throne of grace with reverence, so that we may receive mercy and grace, and be enabled to seek help at an opportune time.
